User: I think most often it comes down to convenience and timing. I usually get it when I'm ready on the road or running errands. I know the location. I know the drive-thru will move pretty fast and I don't have to think too hard about the order. It's also a go-to when I'm short on time, but kind of still want something that feels fresh and satisfying, not necessarily rushed or sloppy. I think location matters a lot. If I'm nearing in and out, that choice becomes a lot easier.
Agent: That makes perfect sense. How does price influence your choice? For example, if the double-double cost two dollars more, what would you do? And if there was a deal, what would you do differently?
